name: BTC Market-Wide Burst Reversal
description: Trades only BTC's 15-minute market. Right after a window opens, if BTC, ETH and SOL together moved a lot in the previous window (average more than 1.5 standard deviations) and all ran hard the same way in its last 5 minutes, buy the side that bets on BTC reversing. Market-wide bursts into the 15-minute boundary give some back; BTC-only bursts don't, and BTC's opening price doesn't tell them apart. ETH and SOL are listed only for their spot prices.
hypothesis: A burst that hits BTC, ETH and SOL together into the 15-minute boundary is market-wide flow (basket hedges, cross-perp liquidations, binary hedgers on several coins) and overshoots; a BTC-only burst is more likely information and sticks. KXBTC15M's opening price prices BTC's own move only. Research (dev, next real fills): basket late-confirmed +7.6/+2.9c (Jan-Apr/May-Aug), BTC-only late-confirmed without basket +4.6/-7.0c. Wrong if the full walk-forward isn't promising or the lockbox loses.
